messages.subject: axes in ggvis in shiny
parts:
I'm just starting to use ggvis in shiny and I can't get the axes to work correctly. We have percentage data and we want to show the whole possible range of 0-100 instead of the narrower range of observed values. Instead of putting the axis limits within the plot, it makes a huge range of values and throws the plot on in the spot where the values occur (often found after much scrolling). Here is the relevant code:

library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
...
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Plot", uiOutput("plot_ui"),
               ggvisOutput("plot"), value="plot"),
    )  
  )
))

require(ggvis)
require(dplyr)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  data <- reactive({
    ...
    df    
  })
  
  gv <- reactive({
    data <- data()
      if(is.null(input$county)){
        df <- subset(data, County=="MA")
        
        df %>% ggvis(~Year, ~Crude.Rate) %>%
          add_axis("y", title="Crude Rate", 
                   ticks=11,
                   values=seq(0,100, 10), 
                   properties = axis_props(
                     labels = list(
                       fontSize=12),
                     title = list(fontSize=14))) %>%
          add_axis("x", title="Year", format="####") %>%
          layer_points() %>%
          layer_lines() %>%
          add_tooltip(function(df) paste(df$Crude.Rate, ", ", df$Year))
  })
   gv %>% bind_shiny("plot", "plot_ui")
})


Thanks,
Steve
